decision: STRING MIGRATION ('block' -> block-none), AGREES. iastate_ext ornamental corn (ornamental/Indian corn = the flint type; scope accepted): "Space seeds 8 to 10 inches apart within rows for small-eared cultivars and 10 to 12 inches apart for large-eared cultivars." -> in_row [8,12] (a span joined from two clauses of ONE sentence, W6); "Rows should be spaced 30 to 36 inches apart." -> rows [30,36]; the page's 'plant in blocks of at least 4 rows' matches pollination_block_min_rows 4. No flint-scoped page gives hills. Figure unchanged. [RULED 2026-10-01 (Trevor, session 3 review): NO HILL ENTRY, and promote 2 must not re-add one: 'Sow 4 to 5 seeds per hill' (ISU sweet corn) is a SOWING count, not plants_per_hill (plants after thinning); the spec's §1.4 corn example is illustrative and loses to the page. THINNING TEXT (recorded, not edited): thinning.to_spacing and its tips cite tamu_agrilife EHT-044, whose page says 'After the plants are up, thin them to 1 foot apart', while this entry's in-row figure is the ISU/UMN page's. Two cited pages, two fields: the thinning text stays as its own citation states.]

in_row_inches.quote: Space seeds 8 to 10 inches apart within rows for small-eared cultivars and 10 to 12 inches apart for large-eared cultivars.

row_spacing_inches.quote: Rows should be spaced 30 to 36 inches apart.
